Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a two-vehicle collision in Conroe, Texas, in which Driver 1 was turning left when Driver 2's
vehicle struck it. Driver 1 reported a concussion and complained of headache and dizziness at the scene. The injury
is consistent with the type and force of a collision of this kind.
Driver 2 confirmed that the collision happened as Driver 1 described. Two witnesses gave statements that matched
this account, and scene photographs show both vehicles resting in the positions described. Officers also confirmed
that Driver 1 was in the vehicle at the time, and a Passenger seated in the rear was identified and likewise confirmed
to be present.
On inspection, however, the damage to Driver 1's vehicle does not match the account. The dents and deformation
are on a different side of the vehicle and at a different height than the area that would have been struck in the
described impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known to officers or to the witnesses.
Driver 1 is the named driver on the policy covering the vehicle.
